subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

She is ________ of spiders.
solution:
The correct answer is '**afraid**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**afraid**" means feeling fear or anxiety. (डरा हुआ)
 
• The sentence implies that the person has a fear of spiders, making "**afraid**" the most suitable option.
 
• The other options: "**interest**," "**fear**," and "**frightening**" do not fit the grammatical context as appropriately.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 2**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *She is afraid__ of spiders.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Interest (रुचि)**: refers to curiosity or attention toward something.
 
• **Fear (डर)**: refers to an emotion of being scared, but it doesn't fit grammatically in this context.
 
• **Frightening (डरावना)**: refers to something that causes fear, but it is an adjective and doesn't suit the blank.
